top_signals.title: Malaysia’s 2027 Spending Plan: Winners and Losers
top_signals.summary: Malaysia’s retail and tourism sectors are set to benefit as the government increases cash aid and raises the minimum wage to ease cost-of-living pressures in what could be Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s final budget before a national election.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: KKR Bans Non-Competes for Lower-Paid US Portfolio Company Staff
top_signals.summary: KKR & Co. has prohibited non-compete agreements for lower-paid employees at its US portfolio companies, aiming to show that the restrictive contracts aren’t needed for firms to remain competitive.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
